lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu₂CdSe₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 28 atoms—8 Eu, 8 Cd, and 12 Se—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cd and Eu centers each surrounded by eight Se neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Se centers coordinate to two Cd and two Eu neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Se-centered 8-vertex coordination polyhedra.
